Wedding First Dance

Personalised first dance choreography for your wedding, whether you want a romantic, elegant routine or something fun and full of surprises.

No dance experience is needed. Our choreographers work with you at your own pace, helping you feel relaxed and confident.

What we offer

  • Personalised wedding first dance choreography.
  • A routine suited to the style you have in mind.
  • Friendly, experienced choreographers.
  • Support at your own pace, including for complete beginners.

Prices & enquiries

Email us for prices and availability. Include your wedding date and any ideas you have for your first dance.
